items.statement: The on-call rotation can support at most three services in production.
quotes: The current on-call rotation can support at most three services in production.

items.statement: Current staffing does not support five services by the end of Q3.
quotes: The current staffing does not support running five services by the end of Q3.

items.statement: A fourth service may be possible if two engineers join in H2.
quotes: We may be able to add a fourth service if two engineers join in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Four of eight engineers have run a service with an independent pipeline.
quotes: Four of the eight engineers have operated a service with an independent deployment pipeline before.

items.statement: Training the other four is expected to take about six weeks.
quotes: Training the remaining four is expected to take about six weeks.

items.statement: Nobody on the team has run a distributed trace in production.
quotes: Nobody on the team has run a distributed trace in production.
